analysis.title: ORCL Credit: The Bonds Have Cleared, The Clouds Have Not
key_insights: Last week's $20bn-and-done funding message implies ORCL's US IG index debt will exceed $125bn but stay well below bank levels. MS says the related deal is not a clearing event.
Vendor financing and growing lease liabilities will keep leverage elevated. Less transparency and potential asset encumbrance add to unsecured credit risk.
The $10bn WNG bond deal and $10bn stock offering match the Analyst Day plan but arrive sooner than expected and contradict February's guidance of no more CY26 bonds.
The deal had no 30Y tranche, which MS had anticipated. The 10s30s curve flattened month over month and dipped inside 30bp, which MS reads as a near-term floor.
The $20bn-and-done message excludes refinancing. Bonds of $5bn, $4.75bn and $6.25bn mature in CY27, CY28 and CY29 respectively, excluding the new $2bn 7% Nov'29.
Other near-term maturities: about $5bn of extendible ORCL term loan due Aug'27, and Abilene's roughly $2bn Phase 1 construction loan due Jan'28 with two one-year extension options.
ORCL's cash walk implies tens of billions of potential 5Y vendor financing. MS expects it to be less transparent, and Moody's now treats it as debt-like.

AMZN will grant a security interest in certain purchased assets under its new facility of up to $80bn, with principal repayments outside FCF. A similar ORCL structure could prime unsecured bonds, so MS flags a potential ~20% priority threshold for unsecured/CFR rating parity.
Supplier financing is drawing scrutiny, and also interest as a capital source, across IG and LevFin investors. MS says near-term DELL spread pressure feels warranted pending clarity.
MS stays medium-term cautious on ORCL credit with less conviction, given improved bondholder compensation, and is not stepping in at current levels.
Favorable technicals from limited further ORCL AI-infrastructure public issuance must be weighed against refinancing needs outside the $20bn and a busy week of broader AI ecosystem supply.

sector_views.rationale: MS stays medium-term cautious on ORCL credit because of elevated leverage, lease liabilities, vendor financing and possible asset encumbrance. Conviction is lower after spreads widened.

trade_ideas.risk: Constructive updates on RPO/growth and financing clarity, creative financing support, and CDS technicals (basis selling, construction loan hedge unwinds, fast-money profit taking).

risk_factors: Vendor financing and lease liabilities keep ORCL leverage elevated with less transparency.
Potential asset encumbrance from a structure like AMZN's could prime unsecured bondholders.
Refinancing needs outside the $20bn: CY27-29 bond maturities, the extendible term loan due Aug'27 and the Abilene construction loan due Jan'28.
Busy week of broader AI ecosystem debt supply.
Supplier financing scrutiny could pressure DELL spreads.
charts_described: Exhibit 1 plots ORCL 10s30s flattening to about 30bp over the past couple of sessions.
Exhibit 2 shows ORCL 5Y CDS gave up its Analyst Day move.
Exhibit 3 shows new ORCL CUSIPs settling into the curve, with the dollar-adjusted G-spread comparison keeping MS focused on the 35s.
vol_and_positioning: ORCL 5Y CDS gave up its Analyst Day move, currently +305bp per the trade table.
ORCL 10s30s curve flattened to about 30bp over the past couple of sessions.
New ORCL CUSIPs settled into the curve. Differing dollar prices complicate relative value, but on a dollar-adjusted basis MS is still comfortable focusing on the 35s.
CDS technicals listed as risks to the short: basis selling, construction loan hedge unwinds and fast-money outright short profit taking. Lender hedging may also be a key CDS driver.

tension_points.bull_case: The $20bn-and-done message implies limited further AI-infrastructure public issuance, a favorable technical, and bondholders now get better risk compensation after the spread widening.
tension_points.bear_case: Refinancing needs sit outside the $20bn, vendor financing and leases keep leverage elevated, and a possible asset-secured structure could prime unsecured bonds.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Constructive updates on RPO/growth and financing clarity, or creative financing support, would hurt the short thesis.
